keyword.en: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump output and pumping distance inquiry
keyword.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机输送量与输送距离询盘

title.en: Match output and distance to the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump page before you ask Xingtai
title.zh: 先把输送量和距离对照柴油搅拌泵一体机页面，再向邢台询盘

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump at /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump. Copy only the printed cells: Model Diesel Mixer Integrated; Diesel Engine 4108 / 66–75 kW; Theoretical Output 25 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³; Stone Capacity (H / V, ≤ 1 inch)
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油搅拌泵一体机列在 /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump。只抄已印格子：型号 Diesel Mixer Integrated; 柴油机 4108 / 66–75 kW; 理论输送量 25 m³/h; 最大出口压力 23 MPa; 料斗容积 0.4 m³; 细石输送（水平/垂直） 100 / 300 m; 13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 / 180 m; 24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 40 / 120 m; 外形尺寸 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm; 整机重量 4200 kg; 系列说明 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 mode

h1.en: Output and distance decide whether the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump row fits
h1.zh: 输送量和距离决定柴油搅拌泵一体机这一行是否合适

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump at /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump. Copy only the printed cells: Model Diesel Mixer Integrated; Diesel Engine 4108 / 66–75 kW; Theoretical Output 25 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³; Stone Capacity (H / V, ≤ 1 inch) 100 / 300 m; 13 mm Stone (H / V) 60 / 180 m; 24 mm Stone (H / V) 40 / 120 m; Dimensions (L×W×H) 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm; Main Unit Weight 4200 kg; Series Note 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm and Main Unit Weight is 4200 kg. The printed output cell is 25 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. This page does not print a horizontal / vertical pair. Leave that cell blank and ask Xingtai. Do not copy a distance from a different model. The printed power cell is 4108 / 66–75 kW. Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. This page does not print a maximum aggregate or particle size. Send the size anyway, and ask Xingtai whether this listed part or machine accepts it. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai. The photograph on this note is a content image from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bulldozer. It shows: British Challenger 2 tank fitted with pivoting dozer blade, 2020. It is a reference picture for the inquiry topic. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油搅拌泵一体机列在 /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump。只抄已印格子：型号 Diesel Mixer Integrated; 柴油机 4108 / 66–75 kW; 理论输送量 25 m³/h; 最大出口压力 23 MPa; 料斗容积 0.4 m³; 细石输送（水平/垂直） 100 / 300 m; 13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 / 180 m; 24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 40 / 120 m; 外形尺寸 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm; 整机重量 4200 kg; 系列说明 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer。运输请抄外形尺寸是 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm，整机重量是 4200 kg。已印输送量是 25 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。这一页没有印水平/垂直距离。这一格留空，并向邢台询问。不要从另一个型号抄距离。已印动力是 4108 / 66–75 kW。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。这一页没有印最大骨料或粒径。仍然把粒径发给邢台，问这一已列配件或机器是否接受。OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。这篇配图是 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bulldozer 页面里的内容图片。画面主体：2020年装有可转动推土铲的坦克。它只作询盘主题的参考。它不是河北品锦机械的铭牌，不是报价单，也不是出口案例。

body.en: Put /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump in the subject. The published cells are: Model Diesel Mixer Integrated; Diesel Engine 4108 / 66–75 kW; Theoretical Output 25 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³; Stone Capacity (H / V, ≤ 1 inch) 100 / 300 m; 13 mm Stone (H / V) 60 / 180 m; 24 mm Stone (H / V) 40 / 120 m; Dimensions (L×W×H) 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm; Main Unit Weight 4200 kg; Series Note 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer. Leave any cell the page does not print empty.
body.zh: 主题里写上 /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump。已公布的格子是：型号 Diesel Mixer Integrated; 柴油机 4108 / 66–75 kW; 理论输送量 25 m³/h; 最大出口压力 23 MPa; 料斗容积 0.4 m³; 细石输送（水平/垂直） 100 / 300 m; 13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 / 180 m; 24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 40 / 120 m; 外形尺寸 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm; 整机重量 4200 kg; 系列说明 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer。页面没有印的格子保持空白。

heading.en: Output, distance, power and particle size
heading.zh: 输送量、距离、动力和粒径

body.en: The printed output cell is 25 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. This page does not print a horizontal / vertical pair. Leave that cell blank and ask Xingtai. Do not copy a distance from a different model. The printed power cell is 4108 / 66–75 kW. Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. This page does not print a maximum aggregate or particle size. Send the size anyway, and ask Xingtai whether this listed part or machine accepts it.
body.zh: 已印输送量是 25 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。这一页没有印水平/垂直距离。这一格留空，并向邢台询问。不要从另一个型号抄距离。已印动力是 4108 / 66–75 kW。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。这一页没有印最大骨料或粒径。仍然把粒径发给邢台，问这一已列配件或机器是否接受。

heading.en: What to ask Xingtai instead of guessing
heading.zh: 该问邢台，而不是自己猜

body.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. Also send country and purchase timing as facts about your order. Do not turn them into a promised lead time or an export-country list. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
body.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。同时把国家和采购时间作为订单事实发来。不要把它们写成承诺交期，也不要写成出口国名单。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

question.en: Is a price printed for the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump?
question.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机印了价格吗？

answer.en: No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
answer.zh: 产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

answer.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。
